human_review_reason: The record accurately describes the source, but the scope question requires human judgment: a corporate earnings 8-K may have archival value if it reveals sector-specific developments, weather impacts on utilities, regulatory changes, or other energy-sector macro signals, even if it doesn't fit the narrow definition of market structure or macro catalysts.
